theorem fderiv_eq_on_curve_velocity
    {s : Set E} {f g : E → F} {c : ℝ → E} {t₀ : ℝ} {v : E}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (c t₀))
    (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (c t₀))
    (hc : HasDerivAt c v t₀)
    (hcs : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 t₀, c t ∈ s)
    (hfg : f =ᶠ[𝓝[s] (c t₀)] g) :
    fderiv ℝ f (c t₀) v = fderiv ℝ g (c t₀) v
